spans.s:
mn. (-रः-रं)
1 Fear, terror.
2 A hole in the ground.
n. (-रं)
A conch shell.
ind.
A little.
f. (-रा-री)
1 A natural or artificial excavation in a mountain, a cave, a cavern, a grotto, &c.
2 A valley.
E.
दॄ to divide, to dread, &c. affix अप्.

m. plu. (-राः)
A wife.
E.
दॄ to take, to tear, (a husband,) affix घञ्; also दारा.

f. (-रा)
A wife: see दार.

m. (-णिः)
An eddy, a current.
E.
दॄ to tear (down the banks), affix अणि; some bocks read दारणि, and others आरणि.

Terror.
2

A mountain.
3 A precipice.
4 The heart.
5 A bank or mound.
6 A tribe of barbarians.
E.
दॄ to divide or tear, अदि Uṇādi aff.

mf. (-दः-दा)
A country bordering on Kashmir, the mountains about Kashmir and above Peshawer.
m. (-दः)
1 Fear, terror.
2 A tribe of barbarians.
E.
अच् added to the former.

m. (-दः)
1 A sort of poison, one brought from the country named

Darad.
2

Quicksilver.
3

Vermilion.
4

The ocean.
E.
दारदृ a country, &c. affix अण्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Slightly or a little burst or opened.
E.
दर, and विदलित divided.

f. (-रिः)
A cave: see दर.
E.
दृ to divide, इन् aff.

f. (-रिः)
Cutting, tearing, dividing.
E.
दॄ to tear, affix इन्.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Frightened, terrified.
2 Torn, rent, divided.
E.
दर fear, इतच् affix; or दॄ to divide, affix क्त.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Torn, divided.
E.
तॄ to tear or divide, affix क्त.

mfn. (-द्रः-द्रा-द्रं)
Poor, needy, indigent, distressed.
E.
दरिद्रा to be poor, affix अच्.

r. 2nd cl. (दरिद्राति) 3rd plu. (दरिद्रति)
To be poor or needy.

n. (-द्रं)
Poverty.
E.
दरिद्र, and अण् aff.

f. (-ता)
Poverty, indigence.
E.
दरिद्र, and तल् affix; also with त्व, दरिद्रत्वं.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Poor, distressed.
E.
दरिद्रा, and ण्वुल् aff.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Poor, impoverished.
E.
दरिद्रा to be poor, affix क्त.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Poor, needy.
E.
दरिद्रा, and तृच् affix; otherwise with ण्वुल् affix दरिद्रायंक.

f. (-भूः)
A cavern, a hollow.
E.
दरी, and भू a place.

m. (-भृत्)
A mountain.
E.
दरी a cave, and भृत् what has.

m. (-रः)
1 A gamester.
2 A stake.
n. (-रं)
Gambling: see टुरोदर.

mfn. (-रः-रा-रं)
Cracked, flawed, slightly broken, (a vessel, &c.)
m. (-रः)
A mountain.
E.
दॄ to tear or break, affix अच्, and the root repeated.

m. (-म्रः)
A sort of sauce or condiment; also मीनाम्रीण.

mn. (-कः-कं)
A musical instrument.
m. (-कः)
1 A cloud.
2 A frog.
E.
दॄ to tear, Uṇādi affix रीकन्, and the radical reduplicate; what is struck, &c.

m. (-रः)
1 A frog.
2 A cloud.
3 A mountain.
4 A sort of musical instrument, a pipe or flute.
n. (-रं)
A number of villages.
f. (-रा)
A name of DURGĀ.
E.
दॄ to tear, Uṇādi affix उरच्, and the radical repeated.

mfn. (-रः-री-रं)
Relating to a cloud, a fog, &c.
n. (-रं)
1 A conch, the valve of which opens to the right.
2

Lac.
3

Water.
E.
दर्द्दुर a mountain, &c. अण् aff.

m. (-टः)
The mouth or extremity of a pipe.
E.
दर्दुर, and पुट a cup.

m. (-र्द्रुः)
Herpetick eruption: see दर्द्रू.

m. (-र्द्रूः)
Cutaneous eruption, herpes.
E.
दरिद्रा to be poor, ऊ Uṇādi affix, the form is irregular: by substituting the short vowel, and omitting the first र, this word and its compounds appear in a variety of forms, as दर्द्रु, दद्रु, दद्रू; also omitting the second र, दर्द, &c. &c. q. v.

m. (-र्दूः)
A cutaneous disease, herpes; also दर्द्रू.

m. (-घ्नः)
Cassia, (tora); also दद्रघ्न, and दर्द्रूघ्न.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
Diseased with herpes, herpetick; also दर्द्रूण, दर्द्रूण, &c.

mfn. (-गी-गिणी-गि)
Herpetick, afflicted with herpes; also दर्द्रूरोगिन्, दद्रुरोगिन्, &c.

m. (-र्पः)
1 Pride, arrogance.
2

Musk.
3

Heat.
E.
दृप to be proud, to inflame, affix घञ्.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
What kindles, inflames, or excites.
m. (-कः)
A name of KĀMADEVA.
E.
दृप to inflame, affix ण्वुल्.

m. (-णः)
A mirror.
n. (-णं)
1 The eye.
2 Kindling, inflaming.
E.
दृप to excite, to shine, affix ल्यु.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Puffed up or swelling with pride.
E.
दर्प, and ध्मात inflated.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
Humbling, humiliating, pride-destroying.
E.
दपौ, and ह what removes.

m. (-म्भः)
Incipient pride, conceit.
E.
दर्प pride, आरम्भ commencement.

f. (-न्तिः)
Conciliating or subduing arrogance.
E.
दर्प, and उपशान्ति allaying.

m. (-र्ब्बः)
1 A Rākṣasa, an imp or goblin.
2 A mischievous man or animal, &c.
E.
दॄ to tear, Uṇādi affix व.

m. (-टः)
A constable, a police officer set over a village, &c.
2 A warder, a doorkeeper.

INDRA.
2

Air, wind.
3 A musical instrument.

f. (-र्ब्बिः-र्ब्बी)
1 A ladle or spoon.
2 The expanded hood of a snake.
E.
दॄ to divide, Uṇādi affix बि; also with ङीप् added दर्ब्बी; some authorities make the final consonant the labial letter व, as दर्ब्बि, दर्ब्बी; also दार्ब्बी.

m. (-कः)
A ladle, a spoon.
f. (-का)
A potherb: see दार्ब्बिका.
E.
कन् added to the preceding.

m. (-रः)
A snake.
E.
दर्ब्बी the hood expanded, and कर who makes.

m. (-र्भः)
1 Kuśa or sacrificial grass, (Poa cynosuroides.)
2 A kind of reed, (Saccharum spontaneum.)
3 Another species, (S. cylindricum.)
E.
दृभि to collect, to arrange, affix घञ्; or दॄ to tear, Uṇādi affix भ.

m. (-टः)
A private apartment or house, a retirement.

m. (-त्रः)
A kind of grass, (Saccharum spontaneum.)
E.
दर्भ, and पत्र a leaf.

m. (-र्शः)
1 Sight, seeing.
2 Day of new moon when it rises invisible.
3 Half monthly sacrifice, performed at the change of the moon, by persons maintaining a perpetual fire.
E.
दृश to see, affix घ.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
Who or what shows, displays, explains, makes clear, &c.
m. (-कः)
1 A doorkeeper, a warder.
2 An exhibiter, one who points out or shows any thing.
3 A skilful man, one conversant with any science or art, &c.
E.
दृश to see, वुन् aff.

m. (-तः)
1 The sun.
2 The moon.
E.
दृश to see, अतच् aff.

m. (-नं)
1 Sight, seeing, looking.
2 The eye.
3 A mirror.
4

Showing.
5

Aspect, appearance.
6 Directing, instructing.
7 A dream, a vision.
8 Virtue, moral merit.
9 Knowledge, especially religious.
10 Understanding, intellect.
11 A Śāstra, one of six religious or philosophical systems, the Pātañjala, Sāṃkhya, Vaiśeṣika, Nyāya, Mīmāṃsā, and

Vedānta.
12

Sacrifice.
13

Colour.
14

Visiting any sacred shrine, worshipping in the presence of any image.
E.
दृश to see, affix ल्युट्.

m. (-भूः)
A surety for appearance.
E.
दर्शन, and प्रतिभू a surety.

n. (-व्यं)
Surety for appearance, bail.
E.
दर्शन, and प्रातिभाव्य surety.

mfn. (-यः-या-यं)
1 Beautiful, handsome, agreeable.
2 Visible, to be seen.
E.
दर्श looking, and छ affix; or दृश to see, and अनीयर् aff.

mfn. (-नी-निनी-नि)
Vain, conceited, thinking oneself handsome.
E.
दर्शनीय, मन to mind, णिनि aff.

f. (-नी)
The night of new moon, on which it rises invisible.
E.
दर्श new moon, and यामिनी night.

mfn. (-ता-त्री-तृ)
Showing, displaying, who or what shows.
m. (-ता)
1 A warder, an usher, a doorkeeper.
2 A show man, a guide, an exhibiter.
E.
दृश to see, in the causal form, and तृच् aff.

ind.
Having shown, having made manifest.
E.
दृश to see, causal form, क्त्वाच् aff.

mfn. (-ष्यन्-ष्यन्ती-ष्यत्)
Showing, explaining or proposing to shew or explain.
E.
दृश to see, causal form, शतृ affix, with a future sense.

m. (-द्)
The moon.
E.
दर्श day of new moon, and विपद् trouble.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
1 Visible, apparent.
2 Shown, displayed.
3

Explained.
4

Seen.
5

Understood.
E.
दृश to see, in the causal form, affix क्त.

mfn. (-वान्-वती-वत्)
1 Having shown, showing, displaying.
2 Explaining, teaching.
E.
दृश causal form, क्तवतु aff.

mfn. (-कः-का-कं)
A breaker, a tearer.
m. (-कः)
1 A son.
2 A child, an infant or young animal.
3 The charioteer of VIṢṆ

A village hog.
f. (-रिका)
1 A daughter.
2 A whore.
E.
दॄ to tear, affix ण्वुल्.

n. (-र्म्म)
Marriage.
E.
दार a wife, and कर्म्मन् a business; also कारकिया.

n. (-णं)
1 The clearing nut plant, (Strychnos potatorum.)
2 Tearing, rending, dividing.
E.
दॄ to tear, affix ल्युट्.

m. (-हः)
Marriage.
E.
दार, and परिग्रह taking.

mfn. (-वः-वी-वं)
Wooden, made of wood.
E.
दारु, and अण् aff.

m. (भुक्)
1 The Vaka, a sort of crane.
2 A crow.
2 A sparrow.
E.
दार a wife or female, वलि food, and भुज् who eats.

m. (-हः)
Marrying, marriage.
E.
दार, and सङ्ग्नह taking.

mfn. (-नः-ना-नं)
Dependant upon a wife, subject to her, &c.
E.
दार, and अधीन subject.

n. (-नं)
Giving a daughter in marriage.
E.
दारिका, and दान gift.

n. (-द्र्यं)
Poverty, indigence.
E.
दरिद्र poor, ष्यञ् aff.

m. (-री)
1 A husband.
2 A polygamist.
E.
दार, and इनि aff.

mfn. (-रुः-र्व्वी-रु)
1 Liberal, munificent, a giver, a donor.
2 An artist.
3 Tearing, rending, a tearer.
mn. (-रः-रु)
Wood, timber.
n. (-रु)
1 A sort of pine, (Pinus devadaru.)
2 Brass.
E.
दॄ to tear or split, Uṇādi affix ञुण्, or दा to give, and रु Uṇādi aff.

m. (-कः)
A proper name, the charioteer of KṚṢṆA.
E.
दॄ to tear (his foes), affix उकञ्.
n. (-कं)
A pine, (Pinus devadaru).
f. (-का)
A doll, a puppet.
E.
दारु wood, and कन् aff.

f. (-ला)
A wild uneatable plantain.
E.
दारु, and कदली a plantain.

f. (-र्भा)
A doll, a wooden puppet.
E.
दारु wood, गर्भ place of birth.

mfn. (-जः-जा-जं)
Made of wood, wooden, &c.
m. (-जः)
A kind of drum.
E.
दारु wood, and ज produced.

mfn. (-णः-णा-णं)
1 Horrible, terrific^1, frightful, fearful.
2 Dreadful, shocking.
mn. (-णः-णं)
Horror, horribleness.
m. (-णः)
Lead wort, (Plumbago zeylanica.)
E.
दॄ to tear to pieces, Uṇādi affix उनन्.
[1] Correction submitted by Dr. Sampada Savardekar on 20210731. Reference: https://github.com/sanskrit-lexicon/csl-corrections/issues/66.

f. (-शा)
A plant, (Curcuma zanthorrhizon.)
E.
दारु wood, and निशा turmerick.

f. (-का)
A wooden doll or puppet.
E.
दारु wood, and पु, त्त्रका an infant.

mfn. (-यः-यी-यं)
Made of wood, woody, wooden.
E.
दारु, and मयट् aff.

mfn. (-हः-हा-हं)
What bears or carries timber.
E.
दारु, and वह what bears.

f. (-स्त्री)
A doll.
E.
दारु wood, and स्त्री a woman.

f. (-द्रा)
A kind of curcuma, (C. zanthorrhizon.)
E.
दारु wood, and हरिद्रा turmerick.

m. (-कः)
A wooden ladle.
E.
दारु wood, हस्त hand, and कन् affix of resemblance.

m. (-हः)
Marrying, taking a wife.
E.
दार, and उपसङ्ग्नह taking.

mfn. (-त्रः-त्री-त्रं)
Performing a long continued sacrifice, &c.
E.
दीर्घसत्र a particular sacrifice, अण् affix of relation, and the vowel changed to आ by special rule.

n. (-र्ढ्यं)
Hardness, fixedness, stability.
E.
दृढ hard, firm, ष्यञ् affix of the abstract.

n. (-टं)
A court or council-house.
E.
दारु timber, and अट to go or be, affix अच्.

m. (-ण्डः)
A peacock.
E.
दारु wood, and अण्ड an egg.

m. (-टः)
The woodpecker.
E.
दारु wood, हन to injure, with आङ् prefixed, and अण् affix, घ is substituted for ह, and ट for न in place of त; also with त, दार्व्वाघात.

m. (-तः)
The woodpecker: see the preceding.

f. (-का)
1 A sort of collyrium prepared from an infusion of the Curcuma zanthorrhizon.
2 A sort of potherb: see गोजिह्वा.
E.
दार्व्वी as below, and कन् aff.

f. (-का)
Gojihwa, a sort of wild potherb.
E.
दार्व्वी Curcuma, पत्र a leaf, and इकन् aff.

f. (-र्व्वी)
1 A sort of Curcuma, (C. zanthorrhizon.)
2 A kind of pine: see देवदारु.
3

Turmerick.
4

Gojihwa, a potherb.
5 A collyrium extracted from an infusion of the Curcuma zanthorrhizon.
E.
दॄ to tear or dissipate (disease), ञुण् affix, fem. affix ङीष्: see दारु.

mfn. (-दः-दी-दं)
1 Ground on a flat stone, (meal, &c.)
2 Stony, of stone, mineral.
E.
दृषद् a stone or slab on which condiments are prepared, affix अण्.
